_All of this is having an effect on students ' opinions and attitudes today. _

Did you know that according to a recent NBC News poll, only 15% of young people ages 18-29 say their sympathies are with Israel, and nearly 1/3 of students say they sympathize with Palestinians?

In another poll, 20% of young Americans have a _positive_ view of Osama Bin Laden!

Enough is enough. We need your support to help YAF win this lawsuit against UCLA and help fight for students' free speech rights nationwide.

YAF goes directly to high school and college campuses with the best speakers in the conservative movement, including **Ben Shapiro** , **Matt Walsh** , **Katie Pavlich** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , and many others so that students can freely express and engage with the values that make us free. YAF promotes your values, such as a strong national defense, individual freedom, limited government, and freedom of speech to large student audiences.

Young America's Foundation is taking a stand against UCLA's censorship of conservative free speech.

**YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

But they can't do this alone. UCLA has vast resources and teams of lawyers preparing to defend their excuse for shutting down a conservative lecture on campus.

**Will you give $50 right now to stand with the conservative students of UCLA and fight back?** We are looking for 76 Americans to step forward today with a gift to protect conservative free speech. **And** **every dollar you give will fuel our fight to ensure that students on EVERY campus can learn the truth about Israel, Hamas, and the freedoms that make America great. **

YAF does not play around when students' First Amendment rights are infringed. YAF sued the University of California at Berkeley, and won a major freedom of speech lawsuit!

But they need your support right away!

UCLA and every other leftist university are counting on conservatives like you sitting this fight out. Thank you for taking action right now and fighting back.

Let me tell you a story about Donald J. Trump. We all remember Joe Biden’s disgraceful withdrawal from Afghanistan- The 13 Gold Star families who lost their sons and daughters have to relive it every single day. **_And Biden won’t even take their calls._** I called President Trump about them and he told me: “I’d love to meet them.” **He was supposed to spend an hour with them. _He spent SIX_.** President Trump met with each family, asked questions, listened, and truly cared. **[He promised, when he’s BACK in the WHITE HOUSE, he will release ALL the tapes, ALL the records, of what happened!](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=f15f31ffe0154c3e80f2a7baaff1500d&_e=W_lPzJ3-0yEdShbK5wrjvxDckI35w0aFy01WOkkLCCoJ3wSPWGqgYIw8y8rKedTRK9OosmWWomadDUNTVCKGOwkkjMW0Td6u9G-sbxvx0xkyN9fFlGxsdvWdVRJu6WNlnoWzBvsqUYKeUyk_YPsgMlFwoJzfY7c47OBDzuOULf7148zg7tfYKj1uBmbIOOeV0eWd1fU9JIHol5hBRGs3luyko0id3XN9tj32e36Lv2YF1wBvaQsDAtMC8jtr51HL3lv3jAuyu5z284lpgC5TBlmPk5s0LvH65zp5hHmE9-T_0oFiuDgW4SUNCKXWize27oIyILxKm6L1QjvQRbDS3RQ95aLxKr0zJv9SsD4tvP0G5kYuus7xYzlS1z59d6Fk)** Then, Trump invited them to dinner. They laughed, cried, even danced. Two moms came to me afterward and said: _**[This is the best thing that’s happened to us since we lost our sons.](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=f15f31ffe0154c3e80f2a7baaff1500d&_e=W_lPzJ3-0yEdShbK5wrjvxDckI35w0aFy01WOkkLCCoJ3wSPWGqgYIw8y8rKedTRK9OosmWWomadDUNTVCKGOwkkjMW0Td6u9G-sbxvx0xkyN9fFlGxsdvWdVRJu6WNlnoWzBvsqUYKeUyk_YPsgMlFwoJzfY7c47OBDzuOULf7148zg7tfYKj1uBmbIOOeV0eWd1fU9JIHol5hBRGs3luyko0id3XN9tj32e36Lv2YXFeaoWXk3YL1G0qcENPev_RoONkxvrCcf4xV_harBqQmuaudk1SDk2-ojYbsC1LocDfpnMmQt1Qq49kJXGqXaDxjf97uqSCT-VDXn7vlBDkcYA7Q_3tLyLPMz5FwnEoj05kPrXJ4HbiNwQ2NklnAA)**_ _**President Trump helped these families HEAL.**_ _**THAT’S the Donald Trump that WE know and the media NEVER wants you to see.**_ _** **__**THAT’s the Donald J. body:
#
Peter,
Two days ago, war criminal and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed Congress...
By bestowing Netanyahu with a joint address, Congress is not only green-lighting genocide; it is celebrating the man at the forefront of it.
That’s why I – along with many of my colleagues – boycotted his address in protest of his ongoing genocide of Palestinians in Gaza. In the face of escalating violence and oppression, Netanyahu's policies in Gaza and the West Bank should be condemned, not welcomed.
In Congress, I advocate for those left behind by the political establishment and stand up against injustice everywhere; _**I'll never back down to bullies, would-be-dictators, or genocidaires.**_
In less than two weeks, I’m facing off against AIPAC and their far-right megadonors, who are spending millions to defeat me, because they know we threaten their destructive agenda. _I need you to stand with us._

Last night I had the honor of speaking with our favorite President face to face at his North Carolina rally. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=7d3d3ededa97430095a0ef230620b3fb&_e=xtbK68hq1OfWwgRwPSFUI0Yp4Bh-e2Kav8ksFZh7SyjnjK2wh2XGCuANBcnPBPJLC2sgLEzmzUovLdmQvL6KCvn7M7tCLDlcB0gYNG5M9takUtgmGzVeX-J0rbX4v9zGMgA9Wjulaep91Kg0C0lY7QA7YHcXHWgYJarQsa3Hh-ptio8Xyt2xQZPlHkgzkiVGHwk7vuXW_zWtqZZramujhS1eYHUZC4LL-NNqoegwdVRpjka8yl62bOtqfWOaeH9E1NF3QquFpqiNaTz0D2ZbVCniVT3qYMmgsNiVaFeQAw1g4ekTbbS9As47eiXuqBcAjWL5jjDlFHQLX5aWHgiTuaMz6pfm4eh5iyTVqirG_7h0pZc0bVw1rMfQdp56Lz3rDh2dvPdYrV3YqvqGTdxHrg%3D%3D)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey has only eight questions, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
* Hides the corruption of the ruling class
* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=7d3d3ededa97430095a0ef230620b3fb&_e=xtbK68hq1OfWwgRwPSFUI0Yp4Bh-e2Kav8ksFZh7SyjnjK2wh2XGCuANBcnPBPJLC2sgLEzmzUovLdmQvL6KCvn7M7tCLDlcB0gYNG5M9takUtgmGzVeX-J0rbX4v9zGMgA9Wjulaep91Kg0C0lY7QA7YHcXHWgYJarQsa3Hh-ptio8Xyt2xQZPlHkgzkiVGHwk7vuXW_zWtqZZramujhS1eYHUZC4LL-NNqoegwdVR4Nc9kiDp9NH2B5VLz-ldZQ15uxgG56X8sZSdq4sOWWGY6WDaJ7Oj68NBlyQQeBgyn3LvbP0l2Wx28Oh9HS5mgIL-DOGVrJBbPla3bxda80cMswI_McCbq4ecBPQCktvGIDRFhfFHoUyksalvXCjkuy2pxlu4zc3661rDqb966oQ%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=7d3d3ededa97430095a0ef230620b3fb&_e=xtbK68hq1OfWwgRwPSFUI0Yp4Bh-e2Kav8ksFZh7SyjnjK2wh2XGCuANBcnPBPJLC2sgLEzmzUovLdmQvL6KCvn7M7tCLDlcB0gYNG5M9takUtgmGzVeX-J0rbX4v9zGMgA9Wjulaep91Kg0C0lY7QA7YHcXHWgYJarQsa3Hh-ptio8Xyt2xQZPlHkgzkiVGHwk7vuXW_zWtqZZramujhS1eYHUZC4LL-NNqoegwdVQlAyyW3D-pSwRrWG5l6Gxf4JqILB4y7DcZ1VjdkOsF4NSXZcZg-axhLJfDz1NPwYO76k95bhxzIRk5UnA9av4AnO9IKrKq8u7rfY1ywT-NbZSyskUdkLFAYRHZ5jUzkUmn9TgjprJcEQl_10y8LlxV1YtPk8B-J7ootC7XKDGS4A%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 .

## America First, Alaska Always!

Dear Friends,

I was thrilled to join the Alaska delegation at the RNC Convention in Milwaukee last week. It was an incredible experience to stand alongside fellow Republicans and discuss the issues that matter most to Alaskans and Americans alike. But as soon as I returned to Anchorage, I hit the ground running to earn your votes and continue fighting for Alaska.

The morning after landing back in Anchorage, I was up in Fairbanks to participate in the Golden Days Parade, sharing our vision for a stronger Alaska. From there, I traveled to Delta Junction to meet with many of you at the Deltana Fair. Your support and enthusiasm fuel our campaign, and together, we'll put America First and ensure Alaska's voice is heard loud and clear.

With the primary election coming up on August 20th, every moment and every dollar counts. Your contributions help us reach more Alaskans, spread our message, and secure the resources we need to win. Please [_**click here**_](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=a9e67924b5&e=6679001ba0) to make a contribution. If you believe in our vision for Alaska and America, please consider making a donation today. Together, we can achieve great things for our state and our nation.

Thank you for your continued support. Let's keep pushing forward!

Best regards,

Nick Begich

P.S. Just a reminder: the primary election is crucial this year — and it's on August 20th. Make sure to make a plan to vote!

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. Jon Tester is the deciding vote for the Left's America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn't define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C. Jon Tester doesn't represent Montanans. He's a rubber stamp for Biden and Kamala's failed policies. It's time to retire them all. Listen, I'm an optimist. If you're not, you can't jump out of planes at night into enemy territory. I believe America's future will be better than our past. However, we need political outsiders like President Trump to bring back common sense. What Montanans think is common sense is pretty simple: They want a secure border, safe streets, and cheap gas. They think cops are good, criminals are bad, boys are boys, and girls are girls. I'm ready to retire Jon Tester and take back the U.S. Senate! Will you help me finish the job by donating I'm ready to join you in sending President Donald J. Trump back to the White House! We have to save America! body:
Voting rights have come a long way – but too many Mississippians remain disenfranchised

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89618706/487878686/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240726_logo&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmM3ZTY4YWItNmY0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VRX9SmUeS96xQO2_HpLRl8e32Oh6pXteclvkIm4eGXc=)
Peter,

This year marks 60 years since the Freedom of Summer in Mississippi that sought to rectify (among other goals) that only 7% of African Americans – the lowest in the nation – were registered to vote. Efforts to increase access to the ballot box were met with fierce opposition, but today, voting rights remain prohibitive for too many Mississippians.

For starters, a convicted felon can appear on the ballot for President of the United States in Mississippi, but convicted felons living in the state can’t vote. Mail-in ballots are rejected for the most minor and inconsequential of details. Voter rolls are being regularly purged, and polling places are moved without notice by local officials, sometimes just hours before they open.

This is a deeply entrenched issue, Peter. I’m a plaintiff in a [major case against the state of Mississippi](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89618708/487878687/-1357921029?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmM3ZTY4YWItNmY0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VRX9SmUeS96xQO2_HpLRl8e32Oh6pXteclvkIm4eGXc=&emci=f53c2479-6e4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=fc7e68ab-6f4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=9272760) next month to fight against our unfairly drawn districts for the State Supreme Court. Districts have been drawn in such a way that Black Mississippians are significantly disenfranchised as candidates for Justice on the Mississippi Supreme Court. Unfairly drawn districts give way to unfairly chosen Justices, who then use their platform to uphold restrictive voting laws.

And on and on the cycle goes – unless we work together to change things.

As a community leader and attorney, I’ve been a dedicated advocate for expanding voting rights and helping others register to vote and get to the ballot box. I’m running for the U.S. Senate because our problems require large-scale solutions – I’ll work across the aisle to ensure every American has reliable access to the ballot in Mississippi and beyond.

As I mentioned, this is only possible with all of us working together, so I’m asking for your support. [Will you join me in the fight to improve voting rights for each and every American by chipping in $24 or any other amount now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89618711/487878688/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240726_l1&amount=24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmM3ZTY4YWItNmY0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VRX9SmUeS96xQO2_HpLRl8e32Oh6pXteclvkIm4eGXc=)
[DONATE »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89618714/487878689/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240726_b1&amount=24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmM3ZTY4YWItNmY0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VRX9SmUeS96xQO2_HpLRl8e32Oh6pXteclvkIm4eGXc=)

Thank you for your support,

– _Ty_

# Happy 34th Anniversary of the ADA!
---
Today marks 34 years since the passage of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the landmark legislation that protects the rights of people with disabilities against employment discrimination. July is [Disability Pride Month ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMQ6htlkkRDDejSKrfU5TVHxBWGhArqKdaN8yrN_9fpRsUj06o5Ufr4bjmm57FDQj2jHOsC8FKLO22O-QY9DmsFqd-l4LH5bQ3-2vFLAvjO_I8SwF2P0hxrDKAJKbUc60WRlI_TT5HxK1AnLFix79xvc8Eca4s7E_gAc-jWHHeJAh3pZB0KYAOW7jDYbHZpOMKjhVt25hxCNna_ICd_CAKRZU4M__ILioyk8hclfJtSxX5dUeGrWWdWhOvCDZu-cEOoMdXOLqe5u5wuTf_4sfAmNHEKm2Zaj8HTWtD9vCKoigOu04DaUmE_5V4tQAd36bQ__2JJz9NwzKhYgDpUbBfEuj6xkzovc0m7cBnyQA6SRJV99jskloRW2XJqWHYWjdI0YwQXhZt_RbgIlt0w9LZFw/48d/ACJvAzOGQMyo84gbiqFw8Q/h7/h001.sA6IoaTcjQFPUlAdJv8JaDUANm4aAUwnUQA6emttS8o)when we honor and celebrate the disability community and commemorate the ADA. Now, these next couple of weeks are all about organizing and getting the word out about Cori, our district, and our opponent.

How: We’ll equip you with scripts and tips to make your calls impactful and engaging.
Every conversation we have, every door we knock, and every call we make brings us one step closer to keeping an unwavering champion in this seat who truly represents us.
Your time and effort are invaluable in this fight.
VOLUNTEER WITH TEAM CORI [https://www.mobilize.us/coribush1/?is_virtual=true]

Marquis Govan, Field Director

Peter — For the past year and a half, we have asked for your help. And — every single time — this team has stepped forward with record-breaking support. [This is the last time I’ll be asking for your help to win this Democratic primary.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89620940/487885191/-529272306?amount=10&refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240726_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzA4M2E5MDUtNzI0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UWKKJXzxZPSWeuacHMS8lfufkFN2ixWYRTPBi8T-c_Y=) Nearly 16 months ago, I set out on this journey because I refused to sit on the sidelines with the future of the American Dream, our democracy, and our planet at stake. I’m beyond grateful for all of your support along the way. # "There shall be equality of treatment and opportunity for all persons in the armed forces without regard to race, color, religion, or national origin."
_Executive Order 9981_ President Truman signed EO 9981, ending segregation in the U.S. Armed Forces, on this day in 1948... 6 years before the end of school segregation and 16 years before the Civil Rights Act passed. When thinking about my service in the Army, I am most struck by Black union organizer A. Phillip Randolph's 1948 words to the Senate about the ongoing segregation of the military, "I personally will advise Negroes to refuse to fight as slaves for a democracy they cannot possess and cannot enjoy." **As a woman veteran, these words are particularly meaningful as I've watched my freedoms get stripped away with Republicans' abortion bans and attacks on women.** I'm also horrified that their master plan – Project 2025 – directly targets diversity and inclusion initiatives in the military and across the entire government. It shouldn't matter what someone's race, gender, sexuality, or anything else is if they want to protect our freedoms by risking their lives for our country. But Republicans are determined to inflict their culture war on my brothers and sisters in arms. **I'm proud of my service. I'm proud that the military is (currently) a place open to all people who love this country. It is BECAUSE of that openness that our country is safer. I won't sit by while Republicans threaten that.** On this anniversary, I want to thank my fellow veterans who have served and those currently serving. I want to encourage young people who like me are looking for opportunity or structure to consider service – regardless of your identity or background. And I want to ask everyone reading this to commit to protecting our freedoms here at home that I risked my life for – particularly at the ballot box in November. Thanks for being in this fight with me as my co-pilot, Ashley 🚁
---

This is an interview of film director Jack Newell about "The Candidate," his documentary on my run for US Congress. (_Disclaimer: neither of us were paid for the documentary or this interview_). The Candidate was directed by Jack C. Newell and produced by Emmy nominated actor Lamorne Morris.
Jack has scheduled The Candidate world premier film screening in Chicago on August 17. If you're in the area, we'd love to have you attend! [Get your tickets here](https://substack.com/redirect/bafa55ad-6a57-4e6d-a138-4a48670e34d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Without further delay, here's the interview. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7bb08ce7-7dd6-4d3a-9258-f39ccca5f2cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
1. **Who are you and why are you in my inbox?**

My name is Jack Newell, I am a filmmaker and a long-time (won't say how long) friend of one Qasim Rashid Esq. In 2020 I started a documentary about Qasim's political work and I'm here today to announce that it's done!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4bdf759-496d-4d80-b9b9-fb1be0efb700?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Candidate director Jack C. Newell
2. **How would you describe this documentary in one sentence?**

THE CANDIDATE - documents progressive democrat Qasim Rashid as he battles xenophobia, covid, and corporate interests in two different congressional races against well-funded incumbents; first against a Virginia republican in 2020, and in 2024 against an Illinois democrat.
3. **You 've known Qasim for most of his life. Was he as handsome and charming as a teen as he is now?**

I get this question a lot and I'll say now what I always say when someone asks me this, "_I think I hear a phone ringing in the other room - I need to go get that_."
4. **What are the key themes and narratives you focused on in The Candidate, and how do they reflect the broader issues in American politics?**

The Candidate focuses on three different and interconnected themes - it is 1⁄3 a film about civics, 1⁄3 is about the system that currently exists in American politics, and 1⁄3 of an exploration of "the character" of Qasim Rashid - who is this guy and it reveals what it takes to run for office. I want the audience to decide if they think the system is broken, not broken, or functioning as designed and in need of change.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/818d87cd-7534-46c1-84e4-4ec3eee979d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
5. **This documentary was your idea, not Qasim 's. You bore all costs and expenses. And you spent four years working on it. Why?**

That's right - it was my idea and I remember that during the summer of 2020 I reached out to Qasim saying I wanted to do this film but had a few conditions - I had to be given total access to the campaign, no oversight, and the ability to make the film I wanted to make. Basically, I offered him something that would be easy to say no to, and then when I spoke to Ayodele (Qasim's campaign manager) and Qasim that first time on the phone, the question Ayodele had for me was "_how much money do you need from us to do this_?" And I was like - "_No, I can 't take any money from you - that would be a commercial. I want to make a documentary about this and so I can't take any money_." and Ayo was like "_cool - good by me_ ," and so was Qasim.
So, once I was given carte blanche, I then had to make the film - lol.
I'm interested in politics, I'm interested in democracy and I believe that not enough people know how any of this works. Qasim also is a great "character" because he is a smart, decent, thoughtful, good person who seems to genuinely want to help people and make America better and who wouldn't want to watch that?
6. **In what ways does your documentary stand out from other political documentaries currently available?**

There's not been a film that shows the same candidate running against a Republican and a Democrat - and in showing that the film becomes more about the system and not the individuality of a particular race. Politicians are famously cagey about media and generally not open to someone making a film like how I wanted to - with no oversight and no approvals from them. So, what you get from a lot of political docs is no real access - or access that only is given if the candidate is winning. You see it all the time where you can feel the moment the candidate no longer wants to let the team film them - and in this case, Qasim and the folks in the doc never cut us out. The access that we have and, by proxy, the audience gets is like you're with them during the experience. There's almost no films like that in this space.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b598493d-7c7c-42c5-8bfc-d14de39cd661?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
7. **When and how can audiences watch The Candidate, especially for the premiere in Chicago on August 17th?**

We are premiering The Candidate as a part of a series that I co-created called Docs for Democracy at the [Gene Siskel Film Center](https://substack.com/redirect/33cb9b18-ca50-4c77-b97f-d0cd207a0e8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on August 17th at 6pm. Qasim and I will be there for a lengthy talk-back after the film. [Tickets available here](https://substack.com/redirect/bafa55ad-6a57-4e6d-a138-4a48670e34d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Kicking off in Chicago during the DNC in August and available through November, this series uses the films as a catalyst for political action during the election season and an opportunity to build community around cinema.
If you're not in Chicago on August 17th, we might be coming to a town near you this fall. If you want to invite us or help coordinate, email me jackcnewell@zaxiefilms.com.

Is it just me or did this week feel like a whole dadgum year? First, Biden was [shoved out of the race](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u6-YtHj-rc6GnNmBsFVOaJaXtorqOalHU_UUbngN-vUXdg4Gv46p00KEwjVq5XnNudVlp0RI3aLbTT_7d6qUmhrWLaZ1KAec5p9dAOkKwbcyUsFHe46j_-kcVWo4xbViQEXnO5KIrIE0G19ueipF3Xr8mClJkbhIW4MlTdYcEkIvyAc0Ix3l8lvOaYL1DKVAuo9EFA1RMCHT6F3YkgZyf_nBVnFR5DTJt2Kfu6g8Na2od2ugd6C5SEayzFj3RO5LvHvHKmEDDe8DC6pJkE2JlLmMWPtYEz_OFiklJ_RNC7dXC) for reelection while trying to convince us that he could still be the leader of the free world for the next five months. _Uh-huh...and I just saw a pig fly by my office. _ _ _ The Left didn’t miss a beat after their oh-so-democratic ousting of the president, passing the torch to Kamala Harris within a matter of hours. Praise, [money](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u6-YtHj-rc6GnNmBsFVOaJaUYptS00K9-iR0ncczl1WGDr3pVSWG7_T2tfWMhbTeotOJFbQpDh7Hx7ff2icDHyfiS0jHl7iuStw3oqj7o8-ZyyW1saujfpKj2EdwoCUKGkjF_LM9eqCTo48hPUAfhsytMJKV-XtvOOB_6rnyeywGt7IyKEjFvXTi3ZPqpyVXcCwaJNqKFx6Ml_DIhF3WBeEF-y7T9PZ-Gdyajwo4bFSoxrILblpkDV9TEefwntD4-wG9Xgs9PFdEGUDu3WBQ8knNYwKVGUmrcbDOQZPUoxTvq), and endorsements all poured in like her [coronation](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u61UiQK-xRF0HlEUUYgiVSXmDKjRHHUSTC_UArF48t-fGW5jfA4o2WO2vWaALMhcyGp7Q84bt6vr4ILnGiM7IAXCSt1iW27ap7F15q9GEZjY3JhWOfKR0Qk9JrJdPkF55U5B5EPDxfF9psBfCFYhpaCK9WViSe7r1fVAag8XYWkYvrt7MjyosH4ekiLV1ObelETirNEWxPnNmcn6VnZD152M2Bk5kbMi3sigo4jwkcKqs4CdeKqaWdLPsOHWJc3bIM-cE4PgMZSjqXKyofpFi8XOoaY1thl815OqXXURXL8OTgIAaHkxrhe1JEqI94dpR5tdPhfqHcOef0EOrC46FrDk%3D) was according to plan from the very beginning. When it comes to her or Biden, I really don’t know who is worse—all I know is we’re in big trouble if we’re in for a replay of this administration. Then, the director of the Secret Service was grilled in a hearing after a former president was nearly assassinated on her watch. Her pathetic display of incompetence really gave her no other choice but to finally [resign](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u6_6RKpOQLZeJpXAfIWUY8o_dhAnbBedx_ZWP9jp0hQWwWkCIqmSVwp9UI76f6zAvFmsX17p9cFMTnx_ChYESISIvhzG8GKffdFw6ji1v2mePW7d4Qb3WyWLTcprkCLtf_cLrvhYbGZXBzWZGEbsdBvgYTlMYL588fq_JanGjGm8i59_wlfiPh4GGp6p3BXBX5XA1SNvrQVvRAjp8s1r8O0KqsIZNmxB9fddeXYGJ2LJj79WldHjk3R_9haDRy_PPqoG9rM9pJA6jNFyGsFhQeFY%3D), but if you ask me, it shouldn’t have come to that. She should have been fired the day that bullet grazed Trump’s ear. Next up, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in Washington without a greeting from [Biden](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u65zY-sGUC2cH2AOQ4bqQrNbDd_3alaVR5IKDxgjRnhJEGLVCUygmNED7BsNBwzgxROfJPsCALYm7aZwQiGJHGHPK3TzIPdOM8KdANh73HUa-isqxPafVMUc9QUJbkHOKT9_hYr9UJIclP0y0lsrMsOEME2eNRrFxaYICOPt-2BYuxdjhr8tFJkWwncR3B64S5mRo6MrvOBOF3g49be6IyhUKAnGovpoC7ny15LIJT3Vvl_qB1OiBheDqwrPCIO9ITsQKyW4LKwQ6bvHrVcYX1M0CkbYP4FE8HG2mjzW5ifdS) or [Harris](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u6-YtHj-rc6GnNmBsFVOaJaXiCcEfbrXaqcrmA8euIoy6cl0ZOYq5rm2MM_kaaakoPDCU0BSBmhcn-HdVJB8W7P3VpHa7iaWyvz8N0LCo9549aaS9RKVj-sNTd3OtMdyt33aXOa1bQS-_NDIzecY7IHjY1zAMvchImv1mVTRSPz6obd7QcZolmevWLQKl_Z-ndF-klG8D24L3Kfo2aIxGCY1qgpVcKd1bGs72a-mtxWD-fIz6q96EVE3Bxkj1vTqRuK31Fk79Jks8WupJn769RF6KdVM_o3Rcc88hO93YwqK8C0I_vNkYLZXVJVx-4eHJ5w%3D%3D)—making us look like a complete joke. And to make matters worse, all hell broke loose on Capitol Hill during his [address](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u6-YtHj-rc6GnNmBsFVOaJaWDElCldnNi6jtQyhNhpwPCwyZfVS2YPwL3Am_hW69uRd8BfPmzJlgy6ih8wCierjyhHqFG5ZBpWst90vkHu0ne-dAKOr4ZgqR3si-ak0V2JWB-AiJEOjZ-hFmVz1BMO_5wkFX1AeuDEAcP1oTgx0lHhOjeOYRTc8S0WTTCcL1pqjIEQ-X3-B3hVXLk18UxFzpij11aJHGNtEREJid_epeqJoRd4Em3Yei-zYHlQhhYwirNsiq7FapBxqnP5xYaYHQ%3D) in a joint session of Congress. Nothing shows support for Israel quite like our leaders ditching out on the Prime Minister’s visit while thousands of pro-Hamas fools [burn American flags](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u6-YtHj-rc6GnNmBsFVOaJaX12ArNmgaSQoiKCtp-5-rviAP83kvyuhJDm3pO1J4RODdIifvyIjLTrtSonWzr8mZ9ujcyeUMkggcwD4UVcqYr88ISO2LV2T0UleNESUHuqoZA2HSvjUgLeiIdTNjJtFmopBXJm4fdJcN7dWIGtmK3-vcTYdf3SbrFJjSBEbVg8cJFMFAeAj7dU_x6gAahM5IZvQ_QZWEwiqcD6Pf-M4adg3zBJ827WVQtx-v9Y-2K0Q7rI4aPOSwzlicThuR0c8_k9T3Te9INKG_MA33eIDQY) and [deface](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=1u9se9htarl-ERvvcU8u69FkaH5Y7QbpTaJR3FATderlz0If0K33BwcCqhaPFzrezlZGGZgaIJ12XOyz0qOb_XqRLRSwEpl01HTzdM3Wh54BOiigr0QAzM10QztaNFtIatyOT3FHnLc9wvlXvN7zYbzWuetf9kGvXyG1hEH_QeWt0xfCGJi9FBKOyZOr6ZcMsBPgoJ2jIs8wyGLhiHTJ9JKn3nyjwTYkSEf29tME9Ry7IcnEslXyjeo-NxMcXDXwuRWKfezX-o4LFv8vbgkLREOYh4pUTOxDOVCpbAkfjpWPk5ZF97W8Mzt97TuupedL4BjfPWcdWfpzzTDYDam9gQ%3D%3D) our nation’s capital in the name of terrorism. I don’t even recognize the country we’re living in. The protests we saw this week truly make me sick to my stomach, and it feels like our leaders are out to lunch as the rest of us grapple with what's happening. We’re leaving our allies in the dust and allowing antisemitic filth to infest our nation as we trip over ourselves to clean up the Left’s repeated missteps. If we don’t take control of the House, Senate, and White House this November, we'll be in some serious trouble, folks. It’s time for change, and I hope all of us conservatives can band together to make sure it comes in the form of a landslide.

| | I took a quick break from door knocking last weekend to enjoy the [Grainger County Tomato Festival](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=8865970dc3934ac88a1c6b967a58bdac&_e=H5_KT3VdrgziKbvZ_76_QyQCy9jC2vAShZps9-FOS2TxtZRHQuBFqxbXYMDTUqoCoiDKw_LY258jsH-eq0L5vjZjzpEmG2ae0-d5FIOu71V2GswcE9_cpy4SpmrRn1X3tM07kX2vlKGdLDLsUmbc32AeTS5cGXadStqyEgYicmnFNrajJ83a3tBIY1lPGe-lMQznjHPTCOeSDoF-m2g76Gm7ezBGiwWOAZ1cNOfzrxM%3D), an event that's been celebrating our East Tennessee tomato farmers since 1992. This yearly gathering promotes our amazing ag industry while also showcasing the talent of local artists and vendors. It's one of the largest free festivals in East Tennessee, and if you’ve never been, I highly recommend you mark your calendar for next year—whether you like tomatoes or not. It was great to connect with friendly faces and earn some votes. And as you can see in these photos, we even spotted the US Bigfoot Patrol. Sasquatch enthusiasm is alive and well in East Tennessee, just as it should be!

name: The Jill Stein Ballot Access Team
subject: It’s going to be a big week for ballot access filings!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
We’re filing for the ballot in 6 more states, let’s keep the momentum going

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?amount=3&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ba_update_week_of_7_28&n=1)
---
Peter, Next week is going to be exciting for Jill’s campaign for people, planet, and peace! Following the successful filing of over 6000 petition signatures in Alaska last week, almost twice as many as were needed, we’ll be submitting our petitions to **six more states** next week. **Monday:** The Green Party of Missouri will be submitting over 17,000 signatures to the Secretary of State’s office. This was an all volunteer effort that launched over a year ago and exceeded expectations. Signatures will also be submitted in New Jersey for Jill Stein, where there is an impressive full slate of 13 candidates for Congress and Senate. **Tuesday:** Massachusetts will wrap up the initial submission of petitions to town clerks. Unbelievably, in Massachusetts people must hand deliver petitions to town clerks for validation, then go back three weeks later to retrieve them, then take them to the state capitol. If you ever doubted Democrats’ desire to keep competitors off the ballot, just consider this sinister scheme. **Thursday:** Petitions will be submitted in Vermont, Nebraska and Pennsylvania. In Pennsylvania we have gathered nearly 10,000 signatures, twice the requirement, and in Nebraska we are nearly tripling the threshold. Ballot access is an expensive and burdensome process. But getting on the ballot is only half the struggle because the anti-Democratic Party has been making good on their threats to attempt to sue Jill off the ballot wherever we’re successful. In Nevada, where our hard working petitioners turned in almost three times the required signatures, the dirty Dems have forced us to spend over $20,000 just to be able to secure that hard-won victory and the costs are still adding up! With every ballot access success we have, we can expect to keep being dragged into frivolous lawsuits with the purpose of draining our resources. That’s why we need you to donate what you can to make sure that people all over the nation have the choice to vote for Jill’s empowering anti-genocide, pro-worker, pro-planet vision.

Jill doesn’t accept a penny from corporations and their Super PACs. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625047/487899518/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM2MTczMDEtNzk0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PUbRqy1crr36C6KiWuq-95AkG2ZxMm022Feqp1DgRx8=&emci=82617301-794b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=8c617301-794b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
**July has been one of the most eventful months in the history of American politics. **
**Yes, Peter, all of this really happened in just the past three weeks: **
* Donald Trump survived an assassination attempt at a Pennsylvania rally and conspiracy theories about the shooting spread online.
* JD Vance was introduced as Donald Trump’s running mate at an RNC convention sponsored by Project 2025 authors the _Heritage Foundation_.
* Joe Biden declined the Democratic nomination and passed the torch to Kamala Harris who went on to raise nearly a quarter billion dollars in the first few days of her campaign.

[**We have just over 100 days until Election Day. That means we need to be ready to correct Donald Trump and the right-wing media’s misinformation and election lies in the final push to November. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625051/487899522/1184252563?refcode=20240726-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM2MTczMDEtNzk0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PUbRqy1crr36C6KiWuq-95AkG2ZxMm022Feqp1DgRx8=)
**At COURIER, we have the tools to fight back.** We protect democracy by publishing factual, left-leaning local news in the online spaces where right-wing lies thrive. Our newsrooms in 11 battleground states fearlessly call out right-wing lies and misinformation in real time.
**But we need your help to keep these newsrooms going.** That’s why we’re reaching out to ask you to participate in our Sponsor A 2024 Battleground Newsroom Project:
**You’ve been chosen to sponsor our local news teams! Your donation will support our newsrooms across 11 battleground states — including Arizona, Florida, Iowa, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, New Hampshire, and Wisconsin.**
**Can we count on you to chip in $20 now and help our newsrooms spread their stories across their states?** **[Chip in $10 ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625058/487899529/1184252563?refcode=20240726-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM2MTczMDEtNzk0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PUbRqy1crr36C6KiWuq-95AkG2ZxMm022Feqp1DgRx8=)**
---
**We’re at a critical turning point in the fight against misinformation, Peter.** Trustworthy local news sources are rapidly disappearing. Media companies are laying off reporters at historic rates. As a result, many communities are relying more and more on right-wing propaganda and social media to get their news.
**COURIER is on the frontlines of protecting access to high quality local news that makes an impact.**
In order to keep our journalism accessible to the communities who need it most, none of our stories are locked behind paywalls or subscription fees. All of our news is free to read in the online spaces where right-wing lies spread.
[**But we can’t do it without you. Our 11 battleground newsrooms rely on donations from supporters like you to keep the lights on and the presses running. Can we count on you to give $20 to sponsor one of our newsrooms?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625063/487899538/1184252563?refcode=20240726-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM2MTczMDEtNzk0Yi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PUbRqy1crr36C6KiWuq-95AkG2ZxMm022Feqp1DgRx8=)
Thanks,

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/422?t=1001&akid=1305%2E62735%2Ez3p6yu ]Hill Harper for Senate

Peter,

Just 11 days from today, Michiganders will head to the polls in the Senate
primary to decide the future of our state, and this much is clear: the
time for change is now.

In a minute, [ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2105?t=1002&akid=1305%2E62735%2Ez3p6yu ]I’ll ask you to chip in $11 — just $1 a day — to grow our
campaign’s momentum over these next 11 days. But first, here are 4 things
you need to know as we think about Michigan’s future and this election:

* Michigan is almost dead last in the nation for population growth
* We pay 14 times more for a vial of insulin than our neighbors to the
north
* The number of lower-income Michigan families receiving financial
assistance from the state fell 94% between 2000 and 2020 — the
fourth-highest social safety net decline in the nation
* In the last three years, more small businesses closed their doors for
good in Michigan than in any other state

The status quo isn't working for us,
Peter. No matter how you slice it,
it’s clear that our leaders in Washington are not getting the job done.

That's why my campaign rejects the influence of special interests like Big
Pharma, corporate PACs, and even establishment politics. I’m pledging to
do things differently. No more broken promises, no more smoke and mirrors
— Michiganders want results. Period.

But here's the truth: I can't do this alone. As a first-time candidate,
I'm at a serious disadvantage against opponents backed by the Washington
establishment. That’s why I’m humbly asking for your support today to grow
our campaign’s momentum in the home stretch.

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2105?t=1003&akid=1305%2E62735%2Ez3p6yu ]With 11 days to go, will you chip in just $11 — just $1 of support for every
day left — to power our grassroots campaign to victory in the primary?

CHIP IN $11 NOW »

Every dollar makes a difference, and with your support, we can out-hustle
our opponents, reach more voters, and build the momentum we need to win
the primary. Your contribution today,
Peter, will help us get it done
for Michigan.

Thank you for standing with me,

Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

Since launching her historic bid for the presidency, Harris has shattered fundraising records and garnered immense enthusiastic support, raising [$81 million](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625807/487902136/-922886287?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZWJkOTRlYS03OTRiLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jvN-4H9v71fL4l60eJ1CTs_8ELpIAm6iOuXc2QEeHvM=&emci=80a08454-6d4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=debd94ea-794b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535) in the first 24 hours since her campaign went public with 1.1 million individual donors, 62% of them being first-time donations. **** _Attorney General Todd Rokita is Under Investigation... Again_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625808/487902137/-1977203500?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZWJkOTRlYS03OTRiLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jvN-4H9v71fL4l60eJ1CTs_8ELpIAm6iOuXc2QEeHvM=&emci=80a08454-6d4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=debd94ea-794b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535)**[ Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89625809/487902138/-1977203500?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZWJkOTRlYS03OTRiLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jvN-4H9v71fL4l60eJ1CTs_8ELpIAm6iOuXc2QEeHvM=&emci=80a08454-6d4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=debd94ea-794b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535) The Indiana State Disciplinary Committee is debating opening a third investigation into AG Rokita’s poor behavior, after a disciplinary complaint was filed stating that he violated multiple rules dictating appropriate conduct. The complaint came after Rokita held a press conference earlier this year claiming that Terminated Pregnancy Reports (TPRs) were public information which the state’s health department could not withhold. As attorney general representing the IDOH, he broke a rule that prohibited him from making legal evaluations without his client’s consent when he alleged the IDOH had participated in collusion with the state’s public access controller. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Vice President Kamala Harris Visits Indiana Days After Launching Campaign On Wednesday, July 24, Presidential Candidate Kamala Harris served as the keynote speaker for the historically Black sorority Zeta Phi Beta at its annual convention, the Grand Boulé.This was among the first stops Harris has made after kicking off her campaign for president. Since launching her historic bid for the presidency, Harris has shattered fundraising records and garnered immense enthusiastic support, raising in the first 24 hours since her campaign went public with 1.1 million individual donors, 62% of them being first-time donations. Attorney General Todd Rokita is Under Investigation... Again The Indiana State Disciplinary Committee is debating opening a third investigation into AG Rokita’s poor behavior, after a disciplinary complaint was filed stating that he violated multiple rules dictating appropriate conduct. The complaint came after Rokita held a press conference earlier this year claiming that Terminated Pregnancy Reports (TPRs) were public information which the state’s health department could not withhold. As attorney general representing the IDOH, he broke a rule that prohibited him from making legal evaluations without his client’s consent when he alleged the IDOH had participated in collusion with the state’s public access controller. Just last year, Rokita was in his remarks regarding Dr. Caitlin Bernard — an Indiana doctor who performed an abortion on a 10-year-old Ohio girl after she was raped. Hoosiers deserve a better counselor than one who is known for polarizing the office, which is why it is important we get Destiny Wells into office this November. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Indiana Republicans are making big changes to the ways Hoosier high schools will function, and they could be approved by the Indiana Department of Education (IDOE) by the end of the year. Among the proposed alterations is the slashing of art, language, music, and history requirements, and the complete dissolvement of the Academic Honors Diploma. Instead, courses would be geared towards work-based learning which students would be required to attain in order to graduate with the new Indiana Graduate Prepared to Succeed (GPS) Diploma. State Rep. Sheila Klinker (D-Lafayette) released a statement regarding the impending changes, advocating for a well-rounded education for all: “Our state desperately needs well-rounded, comprehensive diplomas that encourage our youth to be critical thinkers. Students who want to work after graduation must be introduced to skilled trade apprenticeships and employment opportunities. ## The Debate on debates & the Media
The media is trying - falsely - to claim Trump is pulling out of the next presidential debate which was scheduled for September. The reality of the situation is quite the opposite. First, the deal was made with Biden who was pushed out of the race, and second, they argue correctly that until Kamala is actually the nominee they won't engage. Its the old fool me once....
FWIW the magnitude by which Left wing legacy media (Wash Post, NYT, NBC, etc) has gone all in pathetic is like nothing I have seen in my lifetime. To say it's pathetic is an understatement. Big tech has gotten in on the game to - scrubbing her voting record, her role on the border and even her Wikipedia page.

body:
| Team,

With the Summer Olympics opening today, I wanted to reflect on my own time as an Olympic athlete, and how it relates to Montana’s future. **This email is a bit longer than usual, but it would mean so much if you read the whole thing.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73011?t=6&akid=15770%2E878179%2Ex7E4ED) _That’s me on Team USA!_ | [SPLIT $10 TO ELECT THE FIRST FEMALE OLYMPIAN TO CONGRESS »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73011?t=7&akid=15770%2E878179%2Ex7E4ED)
---
It is an enormous honor and privilege to compete on the US Olympic team, and I had that great privilege as a rower in 1996 and 2000.

The Olympic Games are about much more than performing in a single moment in time. They show us that the bounds of human achievement can surpass our imaginations.

**The Olympics inspire us _because_ they demand the best of us.**
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73011?t=8&akid=15770%2E878179%2Ex7E4ED)
In times of chaos, it is good to be reminded of all that we are capable of and what we can accomplish when we band together and strive for greatness.

**This race is no different.**

**Montana has a long tradition of strong leaders, and right now, the country needs our strength. That’s why I’m fighting to take my Montana work ethic, which helped me make the Olympics, all the way to Congress.**

[**_But team, I need your help to win one of the most competitive races in the country and start getting real work done for Montanans. Can you split $10 between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project today so we can cross the finish line in November? »_**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73011?t=9&akid=15770%2E878179%2Ex7E4ED)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Monica Tranel and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73012?t=10&akid=15770%2E878179%2Ex7E4ED)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73016?t=14&akid=15770%2E878179%2Ex7E4ED)
Together, we can elect better, harder-working leadership.

Thank you. GO TEAM USA!

_Monica Tranel_

#
Friend of Life,

My name is Lila Rose. I'm the founder and president of Live Action.

Today Live Action is the online, educational leader of the pro-life movement. We reach millions of Americans each month--changing minds and hearts and saving lives.

I wanted to alert you about a growing threat to preborn babies, one that is contributing to the growth in abortion numbers this year.

That's right. Even though _Roe v. Wade_ is gone, abortion rates are _growing_ instead of decreasing. Reports say that a preborn child in the United States now loses its life every 31 seconds.

And, corporate America has decided to jump on board and expand the killing.

**You see, at least 114 big corporations are paying --often pressuring--their female employees to fly to pro-abortion "sanctuary" states like California to kill their preborn children.**

Corporations like Amazon, Nike, Uber, Target, Disney, Starbucks, Sony, eBay, CVS, Apple, Bank of America, and 103 others are offering women $4,000, $5,000, $10,000, or unlimited "travel" and "lodging" to go abort their children.

It's beyond sickening.

Killing a baby is cheaper for businesses than maternity leave. Bosses can get the mother back to work faster. This is calculated evil, sugarcoated as "affirming" and "healthcare."

Corporate America should _help mothers_ embrace the lives of their children, not pressure them to have them killed!

**[Will you give $50 right now to help save at least one baby from this corporate greed?](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=d9104a9930d64e07836cf120cd71a631&_e=ZSC27gqC-W5YyLBxuKtWazHCllIAzl-q4YvMTE0AHwAGIat00zAY_rZV9L8Y4C4-fiA4O8-ZniodGYNNucRoNG2O71ZpGhd-PLwJtHJAyTUrhsIN5QQ6JPffa5ePuWDeGkmXd-IKP6Ewt1Y2GI0UPGOFe9HxZb5oKmC2fht_qOjML5cMgimpV8dGqdufr-2bk-OQGpCxsFbPBs3BgmEMiSeyJIu56XXxPNsP5E1SNQo0aGKCLiVMxF4QU1dlgn7yieYnbxXI6V5qT18kE2PDLLf02xApuR856SrCrnyremMkTkGPFNemQ-rNujD-BPDShMiEgDu0oXTWBy3L3s9U0GgUEO22b4u7CnvRNZn8hgg%3D)** You will also spare parents a lifetime of loss and regret.

Your gift will reach parents moments away from an abortion decision with the truth they need to embrace life.

We discovered that spreading TRUTH in compelling and persuasive online videos is the single best tool to reach and compel millions of Americans, especially abortion-minded parents, and prevent abortions. Our videos include:
* Eye-opening facts about the humanity of a baby in the womb
* Raw, horrific truths about the abortion procedures
* Shocking details about the ugly, corrupt abortion industry

These high-quality videos change minds and hearts. 43% of those who follow Live Action say our content changed their position from pro-abortion to pro-life!

Your donation will also reach parents with _Window to the Womb_ , a state-of-the-art, Hollywood-quality, 3-D animated video showing the development of "Baby Olivia" from fertilization to birth.

**Some pregnancy resource centers share that 75% of abortion-minded women who view ultrasounds reject abortion.** One single mother sent us this note after viewing _Window to the Womb_ depicting "Baby Olivia":

"_I can barely pay the bills on time. . . . I was considering abortion for my 5th child, but after watching, I came back into the light and realized it would be so wrong to deprive a child of this wonderful thing we call life. Her name will be Olivia, too._"

We even developed an app to put the lifesaving truth of Window to the Womb at the fingertips of abortion-minded people on their cell phones.

But as long as corporate America keeps pouring millions of dollars of funding into abortion, we face an uphill battle. **That 's why we are looking for 79 courageous pro-life people in your state who are willing to give as little as $50 before midnight so that we can reach more parents with these videos before it's too late for their children.**

Here's the secure link to rush your gift: **[https://give.liveaction.org/corporate-greed/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=d9104a9930d64e07836cf120cd71a631&_e=ZSC27gqC-W5YyLBxuKtWazHCllIAzl-q4YvMTE0AHwAGIat00zAY_rZV9L8Y4C4-fiA4O8-ZniodGYNNucRoNG2O71ZpGhd-PLwJtHJAyTUrhsIN5QQ6JPffa5ePuWDeGkmXd-IKP6Ewt1Y2GI0UPGOFe9HxZb5oKmC2fht_qOjML5cMgimpV8dGqdufr-2bk-OQGpCxsFbPBs3BgmEMiUbUyKHot1n_GXjH9lvTGhK0GTmyEhrCMwI8LMT2NUKooe99jKU-wBu3IB4ut-FJEGAb1X1wyYxVjNIJKFff1u4K1K0WhBYMmAfwYlzm5C1dLEaHthlvnInIRBFMOINpFYa1eYIa-BAGuSciJM21nfs%3D)**

Last Friday we emailed you about our back-to-school backpack drive and our goal of giving out 2,000 backpacks to kids in our community who don’t have one as they head back to school.

Will you make an $8 contribution today to help us reach our goal of giving away 2,000 backpacks with school supplies to children across New York City?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240726-backpacks.M1hJPG&refcode=em20240726-6867-P_FND_EGR_HWH&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6867%2E2526796%2EvsCWZo)

Team AOC

In the United States presidential line of succession, it falls to the vice president to succeed to the presidency if their predecessor is no longer able to carry out the duties of the office. subject: The Largest Tent Encampment In The History of The San Diego River

body:
he Largest Tent Encampment In The History of The San Diego River | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/67ba9d9b4274/the-largest-tent-encampment-in-the-history-of-the-san-diego-river?e=784f78234b)
---
| |
---
| | | Friends,
This week, I stopped by the largest homeless tent encampment in the history of the San Diego River. Yes, you read that correctly.
What’s happening in our river is both a human and environmental tragedy. Feces and trash are in our water. Open air drug markets are next to our bike trails.
This is the result of gross incompetence and inaction by County Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer. She’s been in office for four years, yet each of those four years homelessness has [_**continued to spike**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=5d34436282&e=784f78234b) and is now at a record high.
In San Diego, we’re proud defenders of our environment. We fight to protect our clean air and clean water, but not Terra Lawson-Remer. She’s allowed this catastrophe to ensue for too long right in our backyard and has done nothing about it.
---
| [**WATCH THE LARGEST TENT ENCAMPMENT IN THE HISTORY OF THE SAN DIEGO RIVER**](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=8e38deb2cc&e=784f78234b)
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=e89d4a91ba&e=784f78234b)
| | | It’s no wonder the State of California has penalized the County of San Diego and taken back [_**critical funding**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=f2a6260e1e&e=784f78234b) that was earmarked for homelessness. They say the County Board doesn’t have its act together. And they’re right. It’s because Terra Lawson-Remer talks about the environment but doesn’t act.
When I was Mayor of San Diego, we regularly cleaned up tent encampments and moved people from the streets, riverbeds and canyons — away from danger — and into the safety of our shelters. We turned lives around and prevented deaths. Unfortunately, that’s not what’s happening under Terra Lawson-Remer’s watch.
Record homelessness. Record homeless deaths. And the largest tent encampment in the history of the San Diego River. That’s the Terra Lawson-Remer record. Let's get homelessness off our streets and out of our riverbeds to a safe, clean environment with supportive services. Stand with me and, together, we can change the trajectory of our County.
---

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

body:
Let me introduce myself.

| [](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=82d32185fc9e437db6b291499203336e&_e=SD9_NlSX9auezVNHDtXyi-UJG_BBknMK3wp45pYKf7rv0VQs55wz17Efpz11qDMc0tbl7abSySDQ1c-BsJ7uGBqe6IrwVsUUsotiuC7d9aEW_gqQyq2D3fcF9elJXa_JPx32ZsXopkpTpD9RNigPP9MrJrrWp9E-AJ7j3LN1PLkstQA2uAeVc9UmV709NNmQksmpYb1oZT4p1U6SYMIogAO-Qn4n1753gsZB-4A0eovfXTVRFeNHcIGd-m34Vj0IyZkvRDU3MKevIVUuDMoaCbt8baLvIOGSh-3ibGqDqaBGv6V87zSz9_YSHbXpoKmS)

Fellow American,
[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=82d32185fc9e437db6b291499203336e&_e=SD9_NlSX9auezVNHDtXyi-UJG_BBknMK3wp45pYKf7rv0VQs55wz17Efpz11qDMc0tbl7abSySDQ1c-BsJ7uGBqe6IrwVsUUsotiuC7d9aFN9C7oNbBWtfZpO1-80qtIo1XdGosniGxHxBnG7Hq99j7kveXlLvnw4-rVrxfQXAbfZgi1toPvCQo5nFMZRUgyavdCiBdP0rJ1VaJrdokj-MUiOO10TW4r0jVhEVnWGTRfJELhwoEvrZBOTC1LgEYpX32_LL8pKqBifAfQMjxaJYJyH1RWsPS-lFEYJXrlLbA%3D)
_Wesley Hunt here._

As we head into another election season, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I'm running.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.
[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=82d32185fc9e437db6b291499203336e&_e=SD9_NlSX9auezVNHDtXyi-UJG_BBknMK3wp45pYKf7rv0VQs55wz17Efpz11qDMc0tbl7abSySDQ1c-BsJ7uGBqe6IrwVsUUsotiuC7d9aFN9C7oNbBWtfZpO1-80qtIo1XdGosniGxHxBnG7Hq99nUhTJ-KvNF1qjIgNrXMB_TpW9TJmHsma0F7Recb3fpw10N49-BdOEuv_ycy4i6L1E5RxoThqjDfKQrNFlDzENBJMljiRNZ3HcIeplwvSuAtq-MBzIm2oVlb-v6CncXTdGneTXAAsUcxaTLlwNbXtEA%3D)_
(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps.

After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never thought I would get involved in politics, but after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation, by running for the United States Congress.

I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn't be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights.

****Join me in the fight to save the future of America.****

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=82d32185fc9e437db6b291499203336e&_e=SD9_NlSX9auezVNHDtXyi-UJG_BBknMK3wp45pYKf7rv0VQs55wz17Efpz11qDMc0tbl7abSySDQ1c-BsJ7uGBqe6IrwVsUUsotiuC7d9aFN9C7oNbBWtfZpO1-80qtIo1XdGosniGxHxBnG7Hq99phXxIzcFyj_RmI5w6Bb9I1ToprV8y7_tGDIYuE4q6ZIG4XjI6TVNJda_prYVees7jiE379xD4NDJOTIKN9b4ogj1fzo8Kx7ZyfGudUNxayzWRZuQ4_uKJD93ftePUNEjACUa0DjxNT3zkLJo7NkkMI%3D)
**This picture** is my number one reason for serving Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation.

Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day.

**Nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and community here at home.

clean_body: Let me introduce myself. | Fellow American, Wesley Hunt here. As we head into another election season, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I'm running. I was born and raised in Houston, Texas. After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point. (Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point) My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps. After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.). I never thought I would get involved in politics, but after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation, by running for the United States Congress. I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn't be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights. **Join me in the fight to save the future of America. This picture is my number one reason for serving Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation. Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day. subject: New poll: Trump has a slight lead Michigan
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1697%2E135344%2EVHzVAd)

Friend,
Ever since President Biden’s courageous decision to step down and endorse Vice President Harris, I’ve heard from a lot of folks wondering one thing: what does this mean for winning Michigan?
Here’s what I’ve been saying: while we’ve undoubtedly seen a real surge of energy from Democrats on the ground, when the dust settles after this first week, a fundamental truth remains -- Michigan is a swing state, and even the dynamic change of the last week doesn’t change the basics.
And now we have new data to confirm it: polling conducted this week by Emerson College shows Trump with a slight lead over Vice President Harris in Michigan:
**Donald Trump** : 46%
**Kamala Harris** : 45%
And with Michigan likely to be one of the few states – or even THE state – that decides the presidential election, it’s a reminder that we have a ton of work to do to make every day count between now and November 5th. The energy of this past weekend is not enough to take our foot off the gas. And winning here will take real work.
Because when a race is as close as this one, everything we do matters — every ad that’s aired, every voter we talk to, every door we knock, and yes, every dollar we raise from people like you in response to emails like this.
And because our Senate race is next top of the ticket in November under the presidential race, our campaign will certainly affect the outcome of the presidential election in Michigan. And vice versa.
That’s especially true because I have a history of doing better in the redder parts of the state. Reaching those voters -- in places that haven’t seen a Democrat show up in 40 years -- impacts Democrats up and down the ticket.
[**So with that in mind, I have to ask: will you chip in $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate and help me keep Michigan blue today?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240726-3-900&t=2&akid=1697%2E135344%2EVHzVAd)

I am running to be President of the United States. **It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.** And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles — making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation’s infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action — together — to invest in America’s future. I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. But we also need to expand Democrats' majority in the Senate and reelect Elizabeth Warren to continue to deliver progress for the American people. [**If that’s all you need to hear, then make your donation to fund my campaign and Elizabeth Warren’s today.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2482?refcode=EMZ21V_TAN_E_20240726_V1S1&refcode2=jbp_em_20240726_b1_kdh_ew_fl&t=8&akid=2288%2E4032634%2ENiMXMi)

Friend, Everyone’s talking about the presidential race and what’s ahead between now and November of this year. We must engage the Democratic base and defeat Trump, and we also have important primary elections coming up very soon. In Michigan, we have less than two weeks before our state’s primary elections. Layla Taha is a public health advocate and community organizer who helped enshrine abortion as a right in our state’s constitution. Here’s more about each candidate I’m proud to endorse: Tonya Myers Phillips has helped hundreds of people save their homes from foreclosure, successfully changed state law to support people at risk of foreclosure, and led a successful campaign to pass the Detroit Right to Counsel Ordinance for people facing eviction. To protect tenants across the state, Tonya helped get a statewide Right to Counsel bill introduced last year. A fierce advocate for criminal justice reform, she also led Detroit's first "Community Court" jail diversion program. Layla Taha is a public health advocate and community organizer with an organizing background in voting rights and reproductive freedom. When Layla led my team’s constituent services programs and our youth fellowship program, her deep love and commitment to our district’s residents was clear. She’s running for State Representative to make sure lawmakers in Lansing prioritize people over profits. Right now 93% of our state legislators take money from the exploitative utility monopoly DTE, but Layla is pushing to hold DTE accountable and advocating for a publicly owned utility. Rima Mohammad is running for State Representative to ensure all of our voices are heard in the state capitol. She’s committed to protecting our rights to access quality public education, affordable healthcare, and clean water. Rima is a School Board member and a faculty member of the University of Michigan College of Pharmacy, where she serves as a co-advisor of the Multicultural Pharmacy Student Organization. # Uniting to Save America Now
---
| |
---
|
---
|
As [many have noted](https://saveamernow.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfee6d8faa8bd945842640631&id=8151d354f5&e=c50c08d277), Donald Trump’s electrifying speech at the 2024 Republican National Convention was a historic moment — blending raw emotion and bold vision for our country’s path forward. President Trump, facing an assassination attempt, showcased both his humanity and determination. His heartfelt tribute to Corey Comperatore, a fallen hero, even revealed a side often obscured by media bias.

But let’s not be fooled—the liberal left is relentless. They will stop at nothing to undermine our values and dismantle the progress we’ve made. This is why it’s crucial to rally behind candidates who will fight to return our country’s moral foundation.

In fact, we’re thrilled to announce that Steve Austin, a dedicated charter member of the Save America Now PAC leadership team, was chosen as part of the California delegation. His presence symbolizes our fight against the leftist agenda and the progress we’re making, collectively.

Let’s fortify our resolve and confront the threats we continue to face head-on. We have momentum, let’s continue to work. We have presence, let’s continue to make our voice heard.
