# Biden and Harris SNUB Israel
### Stand up For America, Israel and for Me on August 13 - VOTE GOLDSTEIN
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/78967172-7f22-4826-9975-75dcf1e8a815?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Benjamin Netanyahu** , Prime Minister of Israel, arrived in the US on Monday with an Israeli Delegation. He was supposed to meet with both President Biden and Vice President Harris on his first trip to the US since October 7th, the greatest terror attack Israel has seen. **By ignoring Israel, are the Democrats Pandering to the Muslim Vote, especially in the Swing State of Michigan and Minnesota? It certainly appears that way.**
Our President and Vice President and any relevant cabinet members have snubbed Netanyahu and Israel. Biden has apparently recovered and Kamala Harris, as the Presidential nominee has better things to do than attend Netanyahu's historic speech to Congress. **There are another 30 or so democrats that protested this speech.**
Instead of doing her job to preside over this historic speech, she is raising money by talking to the Democrat party bosses and speaking to sorority sisters of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc.'s Grand Boule in Indianapolis. **All Americans, especially Jewish Americans should be disgusted by this snub to Israel.** This action and those by other democrats that protested is an overt demonstration of an Iran First policy of the Biden Administration and a clear demonstration that the democrats believe they have locked up the Jewish vote; they believe that those Jewish voters that historically vote democrat no matter will still do so in November and the immediate need is to secure the Muslim and the black sorority vote. In an interview today on Newsmax, Alan Dershowitz noted that this is bigotry by the democrats and "this decision (not to support Israel) will cause the death of innocent Israeli lives".
**Overview of Netanyahu 's Speech to the Joint Session of Congress (The 4th time in his history that he has addressed Congress)**
In his historic speech, Netanyahu stressed this "clash between those that glorify death and those who sanctify life." "America and Israel Must Stand Together" as "we win and they lose". He assured the world that "we (Israel) will win." He talked about December 7, September 11 and October 7 are "**days that will live in infamy** " and recounted how 3000 Hamas terrorists butchered more than 1200 people including 39 Americans which is equivalent to Twenty September 11th attacks as these barbaric terrorists turned "heaven into hell" on the early morning of October 7th.
Noa Argamani was one of those hostages and attended this speech and Bibi recounted her kidnapping. Two months ago Noa and three other hostages were rescued in an attack authorized by Netanyahu and when Noa was reunited with her mother who was dying from cancer and her last wish was to be reunited with her daughter.
Many other hostages attended Netanyahu's speech to Congress.
Netanyahu made a promise to the families of the hostages that "he will not rest until all of the hostages are returned home." He thanked Biden for his efforts and for being a "proud Irish American Zionist." Netanyahu praised some of the IDF soldiers in attendance and their bravery, including one soldier who did not have a car on October 7 and ran 8 miles to the front lines to fight and save lives and recounted other acts of bravery. He described the heroism for the Israeli Soldiers - "**they are undaunted and unafraid ... and they shall rise like lions of Judah and Israel**."
Netanyahu expressed the importance of the birth of the State of Israel and pledged that the sacrifices of all loved ones fighting this battle would not be in vain because "**for** **Israel - Never Again should not be an empty promise ... and NEVER AGAIN IS NOW."**
Netanyahu threaded the theme of this fight as the fight between good and evil and called out for anyone who stands with rapists, including these protestors that support this evil should be ashamed. **During the speech, there were reports of violent protests outside.**
Netanyahu saluted the fraternity brothers at UNC that protected the American flag against the Palestinian protestors which followed with a chant of USA.
Netanyahu called out Iran for funding these protestors. He explained that these Terrorists of Tehran that "Hang gays from cranes and kill women for not covering their hair" see these protestors as "useful idiots" for their cause against Israel
_**He said those holding signs "Gays for Gaza might as well hold signs Chickens for KFC."**_
He made it clear that Israel is a tool and the main war is the war with America. Netanyahu expressed that "America is the Guardian of Western Civilization" and how he was disgusted by Iran and the death squads they sent, including those trying to kill President Trump. Netanyahu made it clear that Israel's fight is America's fight and Israel's victory is America' victory over the most terrorist country in the world.

Netanyahu stressed that Iran's main war is with America and when they fight Iran, the Houthis, Hezbollah, they are fighting for America and our collective enemies who attack will pay a very heavy price. Netanyahu expressed how grateful Israel was for the military assistance from America and the co-development of some of the most sophisticated weapons in the world. He called for America to expedite the shipment of those weapons so Israel has the tools to "finish this job faster" and will destroy Hamas in a total victory.
After defeat of the terrorists, Netanyahu stressed the new Gaza would be a demilitarized zone and that Israel had no interest to conquer Gaza. He expressed hope for a civilian government with a new generation that would not want to destroy Israel. He called for a broader Middle-east security alliance against Iran, the expansion of Abraham accords the Abraham alliances.
Netanyahu concluded this speech that "**Israel will always remain America 's indispensable ally ... Israel will always be your friend and steadfast partner. Thank you for standing for Israel and together we shall secure a brilliant future for both of our nations.**" "May God Bless Israel, May God Bless America and May God bless the Alliance between Israel and America."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7b25177b-ecf6-444c-8f57-fcb5dfc8231e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Protestors erupted with vandalism defacing Property in DC:**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4364c63e-ace0-497e-98c1-e18e6f9e8ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Netanyahu will meet with Trump on Friday**
Netanyahu and Israel are making the most of this trip and Netanyahu and the Israeli delegation has pivoted to go where they are welcome. On Friday, Netanyahu will travel to meet with President Trump at Mar-a-Lago. I bet that will have a very warm welcome. It is the Israeli way to be prepared to always be prepared and pivot accordingly.
We are now almost 300 days since the October 7 terrorist attack at the Nova music festival. We keep the hostage clock up on our [website ](https://substack.com/redirect/d8d611a1-1163-4cd1-ba55-ed52f8262d1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)as a constant reminder - Yet the war continues as the United States, under Joe Biden (and in Connecticut under Jim Himes), has not supported Israel with delays and outright votes to prevent the delivery of necessary munitions to defend itself against the ongoing terror from the war in Gaza.
Netanyahu believes much like many Americans that President Trump is likely to become our next president again. He is not the only leader to think this. **Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky spoke with Trump and posted on X that he " spoke with Donald Trump to congratulate him on the Republican nomination and condemn the shocking assassination attempt in Pennsylvania. I wished him strength and absolute safety in the future," ([See Post)](https://substack.com/redirect/f6aac371-0cae-4bb8-88b9-9e04fae10f9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Under Trump, Israel and the US had the strongest relationship in years and meaningful peace in the Middle East. Trump moved the embassy to Jerusalem and negotiated multiple peace treaties under the Abraham accords with many Muslim nations. Since Biden took office, those relationships have waned, especially after Biden released funds from Iran that ended up ultimately funding those attacks on October 7 using Palestinians from Gaza as a proxy for Iran.
Most Americans believe that October 7th would not have happened under Trump as no one in their right mind would threaten an American ally, especially America's most important one in the Middle East. The US would not have been so soft in its response under a different administration, and they definitely would not have released any funds for Iran. In Connecticut, Jim Himes has been horrible since October 7th despite receiving so much support from AIPAC.
Himes has been supportive of the Council of Islamic American Relations and has written open letters of support for this funding vehicle for terror. He stood up for CAIR post-October 7th:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/91bca911-1326-47ed-a5ce-57974e84dce4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Jim Himes is the same guy who believes that the US should bring Gaza Refugees to the America through a strong vetting process ([See My Article](https://substack.com/redirect/fc42baaa-aac8-4f60-8d31-93d368e2229b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). Almost 75 percent of all of those from Gaza approved the October 7th attack and taking of hostages. This is another attempt to buy votes and pander to the growing Muslim population that is becoming more than a swing vote.
**We need our Borders Closed and Himes as our Ranking Member of the Intelligence Committee (with more knowledge than most) should uphold the Constitution and Close the Border.**
**I will certainly make the Border a priority on day one if elected to Congress.**
**I am the most pro-Israel candidate running for Congress.** I firmly support Israel's right to defend itself and I am appalled at how America has ignored its most important ally in the Middle East and first line of defense against Iran.
**On August 13 th, Stand up for America, Israel and against Antisemitism and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13.**

| | **A Note from CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)** The last couple of weeks have been full of surprises. First, President Donald Trump picked Senator J.D. Vance to become his Vice Presidential nominee. I point this out because I believe J.D. Vance is an excellent choice and I look forward to seeing him serve as our next Vice President. More importantly, I look forward to working alongside President Trump and Senator J.D. Vance when I get to Washington and help turn our country around! By selecting J.D. Vance to serve as his running mate, President Trump has shown that he is ushering in a new generation of Republican leaders who are young and vibrant, and we will continue his message. We were forged in the fire of service and combat to save this nation, and together, we will fight for our country and undo the damage caused by the Democrats over the last four years. We’ve also learned in recent days that Joe Biden will no longer be on the ticket this November! Here’s the thing: if you can’t serve for another three and a half months, it’s time to resign. We need to get our country back on track and save what’s left of it before it’s too late. We cannot allow Democrats like Tim Kaine to stay in the halls of Congress. Join me in my fight to take back Virginia and make America great once again! \- Hung Cao

Letter to the District - Sam Williamson
I wholeheartedly support Bob Lorinser's candidacy for Congress in Michigan's First District.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
I have been involved in politics throughout my life, consistently voting for Democratic Presidential and House of Representatives candidates. I have met and supported several Representatives, but I firmly believe Bob is the best candidate. Help me get him elected. As I have, pitch it today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Your donation will go through immediately if you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express.
RUSH $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=express_lane_5]
RUSH $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
RUSH $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE MORE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
As an economist specializing in pensions, Social Security, and the impact of tax policy on employment levels, I have advised members of Congress by testifying to the Joint Economic Committee and answering their questions.
In my experience, most members of Congress listen to presentations briefly and then assess the suggested outcomes, relying heavily on their staff for detailed analysis. Understanding the details takes too much effort, and honestly, most people cannot do it.
Bob Lorinser is different.
He is intelligent, attentive, and actively seeks to understand all issues.
Bob has dedicated the past two years to engaging with voters throughout the district, clearly articulating his well-thought-out positions on various issues, without relying on consultants.
His comprehensive discussions on education and the environment on his website, which far surpass those of his opponents, showcase his depth of understanding and unwavering commitment to the voters and the issues.
I first met Bob during his initial campaign two years ago, and since then, we have regularly discussed economic issues and developed a friendship. His willingness to engage in in-depth debates and revise his positions, such as on carbon tax, reflects his open-mindedness and commitment to thoughtful decision-making.
This open-mindedness assures me that he will always consider and respect the concerns of the voters, even if they differ from his own.
We both share a belief in the inherent worth and dignity of every individual, and I greatly admire Bob's conviction that the foundation of democracy depends on good people running for office at all levels.
Sincerely,
Samuel H. Williamson
Founder of Measuring Worth
Professor of Economics Emeritus, Miami University
Scholar-in-Residence, Newberry Library

Read on for more information on each of them, or click here to take the next step!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89640195/487950592/-907986478?refcode=ea.2d6b3c43-9c4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2d6b3c43-9c4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkNmIzYzQzLTljNGItZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Gx6Vukeu1wMwFMMAOIwK06REo1mGLS4WfwHIeXUbiXw=&emci=44b7cfd8-6f4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2d6b3c43-9c4b-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** Here are some of the ways you can get involved: **Phonebanking:** Make calls to voters in key districts, sharing information about our climate champions, and encouraging them to vote. clean_body: | Hi, I’m reaching out to you with an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in this year’s election. Our team is dedicated to electing climate champions who will fight for our planet, and we need passionate volunteers like you to make sure they can reach enough voters with their message to win. Here are some of the ways you can get involved: Phonebanking: Make calls to voters in key districts, sharing information about our climate champions, and encouraging them to vote. Most phone banks will be remote, making it easy for you to participate from anywhere. Canvassing: Get out in the community and go door-to-door in high-priority precincts within our targeted districts. If you join our canvassing team, a PAC team member will reach out to try to find canvassing opportunities with our candidates near you. Precinct Leadership: Take on a leadership role with additional responsibilities in our key CA districts. The PAC team will provide you with a targeted list of voters you’ll be responsible for contacting and ensuring they have everything they need to vote for our climate champions! House Parties: Host friends, family, and neighbors to discuss the importance of electing climate champions. This is a powerful way to recruit volunteers and small donors. I hope to join a few of these parties myself! Tabling: Engage the public in high-traffic areas with signage and candidate materials. Spread the word about JanePAC’s mission and the importance of voting for climate champions. Special Projects: Support our team with various tasks, such as remote volunteer support, training, recruitment calls, data entry, and more. Your involvement is crucial. Together, we can create lasting change and ensure that our climate champions are elected to office. | Thank you for your dedication and support. With gratitude, Jane Fonda Please note, some volunteer opportunities may be limited to specific districts in California, but we encourage everyone to sign up to volunteer. | | Congressman Russell Fry, South Carolina’s Seventh Congressional District Congressman, is honored and humbled to represent the Pee Dee and Grand Strand areas in Washington, D.C. Russell Fry is the successful product of the American Dream. He learned from his parents that there is no such thing as a free lunch and that success comes from hard work and determination. Russell self-funded his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina and then earned his law degree at the Charleston School of Law. In law school, he served as Student Bar Association president, helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation, and received the prestigious Civility Award. For over a decade, he practiced law all along the Grand Strand. Russell has always been a public servant and an advocate for the conservative movement. Prior to his election to U.S. Congress, Russell Fry represented Horry County in the South Carolina General Assembly. As Chief Majority Whip in the State House, he fought to lower taxes, defend the unborn, and safeguard the 2nd Amendment. Additionally, Russell fought to put 18 policy initiatives into law in his time as Chairman of the SC House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee. This legislation provided funding for education on opioids, opioid prevention, and opioid treatment. Russell and his wife, Bronwen, have one son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their beloved chocolate lab, Jasper.

subject: I’m truly shocked

body:
#
I’ve got to tell you, I’m truly shocked. Over 19,000 Texans have reached out to request Powered by People’s help in getting them registered to vote.
With no online or automatic voter registration in Texas, getting registered to vote is no easy feat.
This is why we’re working hard to bring on thousands of additional volunteers to do the tough, necessary work to bring these eligible but unregistered Democrats onto the rolls and into our elections.
In 2020, Powered by People registered more than 200,000 voters and helped produce the highest turnout that Texas had seen in nearly three decades. We did all of it with less than a third of the volunteers who have signed up with us so far in 2024 — so just imagine what we can accomplish this year if we keep moving at this pace.
[**If you can, please chip in $3, $5, or $10 today to help us build on this momentum, recruit more volunteers, and register more voters.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240726.OLsBQt&refcode=ema20240726-239727&t=1&akid=239727%2E444211%2EWUjp_Y)

name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: Time at the doors
body:
Peter, here's what I'm hoping for in the last few days of this race.
Peter, I've loved knocking doors ever since my very first campaign for city council.
Talking to constituents is one of the most fulfilling parts of this job. Listening to you, building relationships, working together to improve our communities and our lives — that's why I got into public service, and what continues to inspire me every day.
I've personally knocked thousands of doors over the course of this campaign, Peter. Everywhere I go, I have heard our progressive vision resonating. I've seen firsthand the difference a personal connection can make in our race.
**That's why I hope to be pounding the pavement every day until our primary on July 30th. But that comes with a trade-off.**
More time at the doors means I have less time to make fundraising calls. And we can't afford to slow down in the critical final days of this race.
That's why I'm hoping our online fundraising will keep us afloat, and deliver the resources we need to power our _**big**_ GOTV push over the next four days.
**So I'm humbly asking, Peter: will you chip in a few dollars to make sure my team and I can reach as many voters as possible between now and Election Day? **

Today, I am releasing my final ad in our race against Wesley Bell, our AIPAC-backed opponent. I wanted to use this final ad to give a platform to Michael Brown’s family; to share their continued pursuit for accountability for their son’s death. My opponent made them promises and when he was elected, he broke them. But we can’t stop fighting for Michael Brown. Everything is on the line, and I need your support. Will you consider donating $5, $10, or $100 to my campaign today? Your support is crucial in this final stretch. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush-mikebrown-ad?refcode=X_072624_mikebrown-ld]
On August 9, 2014, Mike Brown was killed by a white police officer in Ferguson, Missouri, sparking a national movement to protect Black lives. As an ordained pastor and registered nurse, I was on the front lines, caring for injured protesters and bridging divides within our community. For more than 400 days, I stood with Michael Brown Jr.'s parents. And took their fight to Congress to demand systemic change.
Wesley Bell promised he would bring justice for Michael Brown Sr. and his family. Bell never did, leaving the entire Brown family feeling more than disappointed; they feel lied to.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush-mikebrown-ad?refcode=X_072624_mikebrown-ld [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush-mikebrown-ad?refcode=X_072624_mikebrown-ld]
Wesley was also elected by the people of St. Louis because he promised to reform the Prosecutor’s office. He failed, increasing the incarceration of Black women. Now, as AIPAC and Bell’s Republican megadonors are spending millions of dollars spreading Bell’s lies, I wanted to give Michael Brown’s family the opportunity to set the record straight.
Our new TV spot, featuring Michael Brown Sr. and his daughter, gives a voice to those most harmed by Bell’s lies. I was elected to be St. Louis’ Congresswoman to give a platform to those hurt by our broken systems. By supporting this spot, we can continue to be a voice for justice and give St. Louis the platform it deserves.
With just over a week until Election Day, Bell is attempting to sell out St. Louis, as he lies about his record as a prosecutor, his time in Ferguson, and what people who are truly seeking justice have been able to accomplish in St. Louis, without his help. We must show that AIPAC and their right-wing megadonors cannot buy a Congressional seat in St. Louis. This is our final stretch to ensure every voter hears Michael Brown’s story and Wesley Bell’s lies. Donate today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush-mikebrown-ad?refcode=X_072624_mikebrown-ld]
With your help, we can be the change Mike Brown's memory calls us to be.
